# Tarun Yadgirkar

Personal website of Tarun Yadgirkar — AI systems, robotics, and embedded intelligence. Applied Mathematics student at UC Berkeley; embedded ML research at Santa Clara University's WIN Lab (FPGA-accelerated machine learning); filed provisional patent No. 63/743,085 for BALANCE, a hybrid legged-and-wheeled assistive mobility device; shipped applied-AI and voice-agent prototypes.
